description: Defines the PrioritizedTaskRunner class for managing prioritized task execution with reply handling, including internal adapter functions and task management structures.

classes.name: PrioritizedTaskRunner
classes.description: A thread-safe class that manages posting of prioritized tasks and their replies, supporting multiple priority levels and internal task management.

methods.name: PostTaskAndReply
methods.description: Posts a task with a specified priority and a reply to be run after the task completes.

methods.name: PostTaskAndReplyWithResult
methods.description: Posts a task with a specified priority that produces a result, and a reply that consumes that result.

methods.name: SetTaskRunnerForTesting
methods.description: Sets a custom task runner for testing purposes.
